# The newest stable major version of each browser that updates itself.
# Generated by cmd/gen-lists; run `make lists` to rebuild. Do not edit by hand.

# Safari is absent because its version follows the operating system, so a
# supported phone sits several majors back and is still a person. Firefox is
# absent because its extended-support channel, every Linux distribution's
# package and Tor Browser are far behind on purpose and permanently.
